    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->
        {"ok", "q", "error": {frame: {"pos_m", "rot_rad"}}}. opts: tol_pos_m, tol_rot_rad, max_iters."""
        body = {"op": "ik", "targets": {k: [float(v) for v in p] for k, p in targets.items()}, **opts}

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboLab unstack_rubiks_cube run script (rcb-limited/2.2).
+
+Run one phase at a time so each grasp and release can be inspected:
+  python /app/output/gen.py pick [cube_x cube_y cube_center_z]
+  python /app/output/gen.py place [target_x target_y]
+  python /app/output/gen.py observe LABEL
+
+The default first grasp is the top cube. After each release, inspect the new
+camera images and pass the visible center of the next exposed cube to `pick`.
+"""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs/unstack")
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0])
+r = Robot()
+
+
+def observe(label):
+    obs = r.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    dest = OUT / label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(dest / f"{cam}.png")
+    for cam, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(dest / f"depth_{cam}.npy", depth)
+    (dest / "meta.json").write_text(__import__("json").dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    print(f"observation {label}: done={obs.done}, time_left_s={obs.meta.get('time_left_s')}")
+
+
+def move(x, y, z, grip, label):
+    pose = np.r_[float(x), float(y), float(z), Q_DOWN, float(grip)]
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", pose, video="both", video_fps=5, note=label)
+    dest = OUT / label
+    res.save(str(dest))
+    print(label, "done=", res.meta.get("done"), "reason=", res.meta.get("reason"),
+          "plan=", res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped=", res.meta.get("clipped"),
+          "tcp=", np.asarray(res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", []))[8:15].tolist())
+    return res
+
+
+def pick(x=0.59, y=-0.03, center_z=0.195):
+    # Hover above the exposed cube, descend to its center, close, then lift.
+    move(x, y, max(center_z + 0.12, 0.31), 0, "pick_approach")
+    move(x, y, center_z, 0, "pick_descend")
+    move(x, y, center_z, 1, "pick_close")
+    move(x, y, center_z + 0.12, 1, "pick_lift")
+    observe("after_pick")
+
+
+def place(x=0.74, y=0.0, center_z=0.079):
+    # The target row is on clear table space in front of the small objects.
+    move(x, y, 0.31, 1, "place_transfer")
+    move(x, y, center_z, 1, "place_lower")
+    move(x, y, center_z, 0, "place_release")
+    move(x, y, 0.31, 0, "place_retract")
+    observe("after_place")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
+    phase = sys.argv[1]
+    if phase == "pick":
+        args = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[2:]]
+        pick(*args)
+    elif phase == "place":
+        args = [float(v) for v in sys.argv[2:]]
+        place(*args)
+    elif phase == "observe":
+        observe(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "manual")
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
